name: Nanae (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Nanae town emblem in red and white: seven interlocking rings outlined red and white, arranged in a hexagon.
history: Municipal flag of Nanae, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 3 November 1977.

features.role: Nanae town emblem — seven interlocking rings outlined red and white, arranged in a hexagon
